note: Each card: the phrase, one full sentence, a second example and a short grammar note. Cards marked pending slipped three times on 2026-11-07 and come back in 3 to 7 days in a new sentence.

cards.sentence: He is not afraid of the Pharisees.
cards.more: The parents are afraid of the leaders.
cards.note: afraid + of + a noun. Use is or are before afraid. "the" shows we know which Pharisees.
cards.hu: afraid of = félni valamitől; kell a létige (is/are), az of és a the.

cards.more: She tells the truth every day.
cards.note: he or she + tells. The verb gets an s. Not: he is tell.
cards.hu: he/she/it után a tell végére s kerül: tells. Nem: he is tell.

cards.more: The man was brave.
cards.note: He is brave now. He was brave before. is = now. was = before.

cards.more: She is a clever girl.
cards.note: He is clever. With a noun, use a: a clever girl.

cards.sentence: He is honest. He doesn't lie.
cards.more: An honest man says the truth.
cards.note: doesn't + the base verb. He doesn't lie. Not: he doesn't lies.
cards.hu: doesn't után az ige alapalakja: lie.

cards.more: He says what he thinks.
cards.note: a + direct + man. Use a before a person word: a direct man. He is a direct man.
cards.hu: Egy személy előtt a kell: a direct man.

cards.more: A child hides behind a door.
cards.note: doesn't + hide. The negative is doesn't + base verb.

cards.more: His answer is logical.
cards.note: is + logical. His answer = the answer of him.

cards.more: One Pharisee. Many Pharisees.
cards.note: One Pharisee. Two or more: Pharisees. The shows we know which group.
cards.hu: Egyes szám: a Pharisee. Többes: the Pharisees. A the jelzi, hogy tudjuk, kik.

cards.more: Are his parents alive? Yes, they are.
cards.note: parents = more than one person, so use are. For one person: is.
cards.hu: Többes számnál are, egy személynél is.

cards.more: She has two brothers.
cards.note: he or she + has. Not: he have.

cards.sentence: The man was blind from birth.
cards.more: Blind means: you cannot see.
cards.note: was + blind. was is for one person in the past.

cards.sentence: As he passed by, he saw a man blind from birth.
cards.more: The bus passes by my house.
cards.note: passed = past of pass. Today: pass by. Yesterday: passed by.

cards.sentence: I am the light of the world.
cards.more: The sun gives light.
cards.note: the light of the world. Use the because there is only one.

cards.more: A doctor heals a sick person.
cards.note: heal + ed = healed. It is the past. him = the man (not said again).
cards.hu: heal → healed. A him a férfit jelenti.

cards.more: Wash your hands before you eat.
cards.note: he or she + washes. Add es after sh.

cards.more: The boss sent an email.
cards.note: send → sent. It is a past form. Sent = someone told you to go, or they sent a thing.

cards.sentence: It was the Sabbath when Jesus healed him.
cards.more: Today is Saturday. It is the Sabbath for you.
cards.note: It was = in the past. It is = now. the Sabbath: only one, so the.
cards.hu: It was = múlt, It is = jelen.

cards.more: I am grateful for your help.
cards.note: grateful for + something. I am grateful for your help.

cards.more: A mother is proud of her son.
cards.note: proud of + a person. Two meanings: bad (I am better than you) and good (I am happy about you).

cards.sentence: The Pharisees are serious about the law.
cards.more: A serious problem is a big problem.
cards.note: serious about + something. They are serious about the law.

cards.sentence: They are angry with the man.
cards.more: My boss is angry about the mistake.
cards.note: angry with + a person. angry about + a thing.
cards.hu: angry with + ember, angry about + dolog.

cards.more: A kind teacher helps the children.
cards.note: is kind. For many people: are kind.

cards.more: A powerful machine can lift a car.
cards.note: is powerful. Not: is power. power = noun. powerful = word for a person or thing.

cards.more: He waits in line and he stays calm.
cards.note: a patient teacher. Use a before patient. patient is a word for a person.

cards.more: A child believes his mother.
cards.note: he or she + believes. believe in + a person. believe + a person (I trust his words).

cards.more: I doubt it. I am not sure.
cards.note: doubt + a person or a thing. Some people doubt = a few people are not sure.

cards.more: A witness tells what he saw.
cards.note: a witness = a person. He is a witness. a before witness.

cards.sentence: The parents do not want trouble.
cards.more: If you break a window, you have trouble.
cards.note: do not want + a noun. The parents do not want trouble. (They = more than one: do not.)

cards.more: Could you say it more simply?
cards.note: Could you + base verb? It is polite. Use it when you do not understand.

cards.more: I don't get it. I'm not sure what you mean.
cards.note: I don't + verb. Three ways: I don't understand. I don't get it. I'm not sure what you mean.

cards.sentence: He is honest. In other words, he doesn't lie.
cards.more: He is a direct man. In other words, he says what he thinks.
cards.note: In other words, + the same idea with easier words.

cards.more: What does "alive" mean?
cards.note: What does + a word + mean? After does the verb is mean (no s).
cards.hu: What does ... mean? (nincs s a mean végén)

cards.more: Go on, please.
cards.note: Please + a verb. Short and polite.

cards.more: Could you repeat that, please?
cards.note: Repeat, please = say it again.

cards.sentence: His parents say he is old enough.
cards.more: A child of six is not old enough to drive.
cards.note: old enough + to + verb. He is old enough to answer.
cards.hu: enough a melléknév UTÁN áll: old enough.
